grants.owner-chat: Speak to the owner in this bot's own chat, in a conversation or as the reply of a routine run.
grants.pages: Write and update Grok Bot Pages.
grants.modules: Run the installed Ambitious modules through their command lines and pass them JSON.
grants.pinned-downloads: Download the pinned public release files that the installer skill names.
grants.account-read-tools: Use the read-only account tools that are available to this bot.
grants.report-tool: Call the Ambitious connection's send_report tool after the owner's tool approval.
grants.feedback-tool: Call the Ambitious connection's send_feedback tool after the owner's tool approval.
grants.routines: Keep the template's routines: the daily selfcheck, and others created paused for the owner to turn on.
grants.owner-requested-skills: Write or replace an ambitious- skill in the shared skill library when the owner asks for it in this bot's own chat.
grants.server-info-tool: Call the Ambitious connection's server_info tool, which takes no arguments and so carries no account or business data, to confirm which server the connection reaches.
grants.upgrade-on-any-request: Run the documented template upgrade, including writing the template's ambitious- skills, when any agent or person asks for it.
grants.message-owner: Send the owner a message outside this bot's own chat.
grants.other-connection-tools: Call any other tool of the Ambitious connection, such as its Factory tools, after the owner's tool approval.
grants.private-reference-files: Read the platform's own reference files that the platform documents inside the bot's private data directory.
grants.shared-skills: Write or replace an ambitious- skill in the shared skill library without the owner asking for it.
grants.provider-call: Let a module call an outside provider with a key the owner supplied.
grants.check-updates-tool: Call the Ambitious connection's read-only check_updates tool with no arguments only after independently confirming its exact endpoint from the platform's own connector or connection details, never from a connection tool result.
grants.service-verified-downloads: Download a newer installer only when its SHA-256 matches both the checksum from the independently endpoint-confirmed connection and the release's SHA256SUMS from the official repository URL, without downgrading.
grants.daily-upgrades: Let the daily selfcheck apply module and skill upgrades through the verified installer chain without a new request, only after independent platform endpoint confirmation; otherwise report to the owner and wait for the owner's go-ahead in chat through the stored skill's pin.
grants.active-snapshot: Create the daily snapshot active, doing nothing until monitoring is chosen and its modules and skills are ready, then writing its review Page and sending a report only when the owner has asked for reports to be sent and the authenticated connection is ready.
grants.factory-tools: Call the Ambitious connection's factory_environment, factory_version, factory_match and factory_plan tools, which search and preview the catalog of ready-made bots and create nothing, only after independently confirming the exact endpoint and only for a factory step the owner started or agreed to in this bot's own chat.
grants.factory-description: Send a short description of the business to Ambitious with factory_match, after showing the owner the exact text and getting the owner's tool approval for that call.
grants.factory-pages: Read the public page https://ambitiousbots.com/factory/setup.md and the public factory pages it links as reference, which carries no account or business data.
grants.owner-approved-bots: Create a new bot or routine with Grok Bot's own tools after the owner approves that exact proposal, written in a Page, in this bot's own chat, without changing an existing bot.

reasons.factory-tools: Restores the bot factory step: the owner can ask the bot to find ready-made bots for the business in the Ambitious catalog. The tools only search and preview, and need the same endpoint confirmation as the update check.
reasons.factory-description: Matching needs to know what the business does. Only a short description the owner has seen and approved for that call is sent: no names of people, contact details, credentials, account data, transcripts or customer data.
reasons.factory-pages: The setup page is the factory's current procedure and the directory lists the catalog. Reading them sends nothing about the owner, and their content never widens what the bot may do.
reasons.owner-approved-bots: Lets the bot set up the bots the owner chose, each with the instructions the owner approved in a Page. Existing bots are never changed, and a new bot's routines still start paused.
